summary: Step 9, the state.md pr resume rule, the DESIGN.md PR section and the text-contract test match spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md and contracts/pr-publication.md; one reuse-path assignee binding is left implicit and one contract wording still prescribes a token the shipped text avoids, both non-blocking.

findings.summary: On the reuse paths (item 3 sub-step 1 found, and sub-step 3 found) the step never states that the lookup's assignees feed the item 4 assignment check, so the check on reused PRs rests on inference.
findings.evidence: Spec US3 scenario 1 and FR-008 ('after the run's PR is known (created or reused)') require the assignment check on reuse. SKILL.md line 159 (item 3.1) says only 'Exit 0 with entries: found; reuse the first entry's `url` and skip creation'. Line 161 (item 3.3) says 'Found: reuse the PR.' The only stated assignee source is line 162 (item 3.4), which applies 'After a successful creation ... Found: use its assignees for item 4'. Line 163 (item 4) compares the login with 'the Branch PR's `assignees[].login`' without naming the lookup that supplies them. contracts/pr-publication.md lines 8 and 10 and data-model.md line 19 carry the same omission. The lookup at line 159 does request assignees, so the check is implied rather than contradicted.
findings.fix: Name the binding on both found outcomes: line 159 'reuse the first entry's `url` and `assignees`; item 4 checks those assignees'; line 161 'Found: reuse the PR and its assignees for item 4'. Mirror this in contracts/pr-publication.md items 3.1 and 3.3 and in the data-model.md found row.

findings.summary: The contract and T005 still prescribe the literal 'never ASK' for step 9 item 4, while the shipped text avoids that token; the open analyze-2 I3 finding was never remediated.
findings.evidence: contracts/pr-publication.md line 12 says 'Continue; never halt, never `ASK`.' and tasks.md line 65 repeats it. Shipped SKILL.md line 163 reads 'never asks the user for a GitHub username'. The no-ask element (whole-word \bASK\b) is satisfied; FR-003 is met. Only artifact wording disagrees.
findings.fix: Reword contracts/pr-publication.md line 12 and tasks.md T005 Implement to the shipped wording.
